description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dated twice on the recto as Kislev 5400 AM: once as Kislev שה׳׳ת in the upper right entry and in the upper left כסליו ש׳ ארבע מאות. A variety of names and titles appear in the entries, such as: (recto) the qāḍī, the çavuş, Yaʿaqov Kohen, and the verso mentions a shop of some kind at least twice. Some of the entries on the recto may reference clipped coinage values (מקאציץ / maqāṣīṣ). MCD.
